name: What should I prepare before Frasheski Construction starts a surface restoration project?
description: Prepare by clearing the work area of obstructions and discussing any concerns about nearby items. Easy access to water and electricity can also be helpful.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before Frasheski Construction starts a surface restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before we begin your surface restoration project, there are a few preparation steps you can take to ensure a smooth process. This includes clearing the work area of any furniture, planters, vehicles, or personal belongings that might obstruct access. We also recommend discussing any specific concerns you have about nearby landscaping or vulnerable items that may need protection. Providing us with easy access to water and electricity can also be helpful. Your cooperation in these areas allows us to start work efficiently.
